shortDescription: The world economy faces challenges and the inter-governmental forum Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) plays an increasingly important role, China's Finance Minister Lan Foan said on Tuesday.Lan was delivering remarks at the opening of the APEC Finance Ministers' meeting in Hong Kong.
